ds4-server (unofficial build)
============================

This archive holds a build of ds4-server from https://github.com/antirez/ds4
at commit @COMMIT@, made by GitHub Actions for the hermes-plugin-ds4
plugin. It is not made, signed or endorsed by the ds4 project.

ds4 is under the MIT license; see the LICENSE file in this archive
(Copyright (c) 2026 The ds4.c authors, Copyright (c) 2023-2026 The ggml
authors, Copyright (c) 2023 DeepSeek). metal/ holds ds4's Metal kernel
sources, which ds4-server reads at run time; their notices are kept as
written.

Components compiled into ds4-server that are under their own licenses:

* rax.c, rax.h: a radix tree implementation by Salvatore Sanfilippo,
  BSD 3-Clause license. The complete notice is in
  licenses/rax-BSD-3-Clause.txt, copied verbatim from the header of rax.c.

* third_party/iris: image decoding headers (jpeg.h, png.h) by Salvatore
  Sanfilippo, MIT license. See third_party/iris/LICENSE.

The DeepSeek model files ds4-server loads are not part of this archive and
are governed by their own license.
